$comment: Measured from the local mirror (site/, served by server.js) via in-app navigation at 1440x900, 768x1024 and 390x844 — see design-repo/extraction/evidence/computed-*.json. Deep app routes 301 to '/' on a direct load (same as the original host); they are reached only by in-app navigation. No component source exists (compiled Nuxt build only), so sections carry no implementedBy.

meta.mirror: site/ — production Nuxt static build, static payload dir 1758021745

categories.SHELL: Fixed chrome shared by the app routes: top navigation pills, bottom chapter/explore menu, footer.
categories.RUNTIME: Utility UI that is part of the experience engine rather than page content: preloader, sound gate, WebGL stage, custom cursor.
categories.MEDIA: Audio playback UI for book/chapter narration.
categories.NAVIGATION: Content whose job is finding chapters: the draggable illustrated map and the chapter list.
categories.CHAPTER: The parts of a single chapter summary page.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial prose blocks about the book and its author.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is getting the book: download/order actions.

shell.header-nav.description: Fixed top bar: two white pill links ('Chapter summaries', 'About the book') on the left and a 'Download' pill with a tilted book thumbnail on the right. Pills wipe to an alternate label on hover.
shell.header-nav.scope: Present on all 16 app routes; the Download pill is hidden on the 12 chapter routes.

shell.bottom-menu.description: Fixed bottom-centre pill reading 'Chapter' / 'Explore' around a round dark toggle button that switches between the chapter list and the explore map.
shell.bottom-menu.scope: Present on all 16 app routes (not rendered at 390px on the explore map).

shell.footer.description: Yellow full-width bar at the very end of the About page: copyright line on the left, underlined 'Visit my online portfolio' link on the right.

runtime.preloader.description: First-load loader on sage background: giant condensed number words counting up ('ONE … HUNDRED'), the book cover rising with a drop shadow, and a 'Loading Chapters' label; dismisses into the intro.
runtime.preloader.scope: Only on the 1 intro route, first load only.

runtime.sound-gate.description: Yellow 'Enter without sound' pill (bottom-right) with a muted-speaker icon; the alternative to the intro's arrow button, which enters with sound on.
runtime.sound-gate.scope: Only on the 1 intro route, until the visitor enters.

runtime.webgl-stage.description: Fixed full-screen WebGL canvas rendering the 3D book and the illustrated city backdrop, plus the drag grid that pans it.

runtime.cursor.description: Custom canvas cursor (open-hand / grabbing / pointer states) that replaces the system cursor on hover-capable devices.
runtime.cursor.scope: On all 16 app routes, desktop/hover devices only.

hero.book-intro.description: Centred stack of slightly rotated white paper cards holding the author portrait badge with circular 'THE NEW BOOK' text, the book wordmark, a one-line tagline (h1), the author signature, and a round yellow arrow button that enters the site.

hero.about-title.description: Viewport-high opener of the About page: giant 'ABOUT' condensed type behind a tilted 3D book, the author signature and an animated hot-air balloon.

media.audio-player.description: White pill audio player: author avatar, title ('CH. BOOK SYNOPSIS' or the chapter number), play button, elapsed time, waveform/timeline canvas, total duration.
media.audio-player.scope: On 13 routes: fixed at the bottom of the intro, in-flow above the card on the 12 chapter routes.

navigation.explore-map.description: Draggable illustrated city map (WebGL) with chapter titles floating over their scenes, and a 'Drag around to find chapters' hint chip with a yellow icon that follows the cursor.

navigation.chapter-index.description: Full-screen black chapter list: vertically scrolling 'CH. 01…12' numerals with a hover preview, a 'Scroll through chapters' side label, top links ('Order the book', the author's name), an animated book in the centre and a close button.

chapter.header.description: Top of the chapter paper card: small 'Ch.' label, the chapter number as a giant condensed word (e.g. 'One'), and the chapter headline (h2, two clauses joined by an em dash), over a line-drawn chapter illustration.

chapter.body.description: Chapter summary prose under the header rule: 3–4 paragraphs (90–167 words) with bold and underlined emphasis marks.

chapter.pager.description: Fixed chapter controls: round close (X) button top-right and white 'Prev' / dark 'Next' pills at the bottom corners, linking to adjacent chapters.

content.about-book.description: First About copy block: small 'Intro to the book' eyebrow, a large condensed first-person heading, and story paragraphs about the author's working life, set right of a large animated line-drawn illustration.

content.about-story.description: Two-column story block: a large condensed first-person heading on one side and story paragraphs on the other. Appears twice, each one preceded by an illustration strip.
content.about-story.scope: Only on the 1 About route (2 instances).

gallery.illustration-strip.description: Full-width row of tall illustration figures, 2 columns below 650px and 4 columns at 650px and up.
gallery.illustration-strip.scope: Only on the 1 About route (2 instances).

cta.download-closer.description: About page closer over a full-width bottom illustration: centred animated illustration/heading, a 4-figure stats row about the book (word count, copies sold, illustrated scenes, pages), and a Download pill with the tilted book.

cta.download-formats.description: Standalone download page: two centred cards, PRINT BOOK (cover image + 'Download PDF') and AUDIOBOOK (cover image + 'Download Audio'), on a colour-changing background.
